settings.reading.layout.title: Page View Layout
settings.reading.desc1: In Horizontal pages, drag a page sideways to turn it (when not in draw mode). Free scroll lets you zoom out with Ctrl+scroll to see several pages and pan freely; Snap moves one page per swipe; Peek snaps but shows a sliver of the neighbouring pages.
settings.reading.desc2: Tip: Ctrl + scroll zooms pages in either layout. The current page always re-centres as you read.
settings.integrations.name.title: Your name
settings.integrations.name.label: Display name
settings.integrations.name.desc: Used to name your own annotation set, and stamped into exports so the people you share .srbook files with see who sent them. Defaults to your computer's login name.
settings.integrations.discord.title: Discord
settings.integrations.discord.label: Show reading status on Discord
settings.integrations.discord.desc: When on, Lemur tells your desktop Discord app what you're reading (e.g. "Reading Title · 34%"). Only works while the Discord desktop app is running on this computer, and only you control it — it's off until you enable it here.
settings.integrations.discord.unavailabl: Discord integration is only available in the desktop app.
settings.data.backup.title: Back up your library
settings.data.backup.desc: Everything — your books, annotations, every version, collections and settings — lives in one folder. Save a backup file anywhere (a USB drive, cloud folder, another PC) and restore it later or on a new machine.
settings.data.folder.title: Data folder
settings.data.snapshots.title: Automatic safety copies
settings.data.snapshots.desc: Before any restore, Lemur saves a snapshot of your current library here automatically (the last few are kept). If a restore goes wrong, you can roll back to one of these.
settings.about.tagline: A modular study platform for speed reading, annotation, and knowledge mapping.
settings.about.legal: Lemur is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later. It comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY.

Reset "{name}"?

This erases its notes, bookmarks, drawings, and mind-map but keeps the book in your library. This can't be undone.

Delete "{name}" from your library?

This removes the book and erases all its saved data (notes, bookmarks, drawings, mind-map). Your original file on disk is NOT touched. This can't be undone.

Delete collection "{name}"?

settings.player.scrubber.desc: The reading-progress bar across the top of the player — it fills up as you read. The style changes how that bar and its filled portion look.
settings.comfort.desc: Easier-on-the-eyes reading for long sessions. Two profiles — Daytime and Nighttime — each fully configurable. The optional schedule switches between them automatically. Affects the page view.
settings.comfort.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.comfort.dark.desc: Inverts the page so paper goes dark and text light. Detected illustrations keep their real colours.
settings.comfort.paper.title: Paper colour (light mode)
settings.comfort.schedule.title: Automatic day / night
settings.comfort.schedule.desc: During these hours the Nighttime profile is shown; the Daytime profile shows the rest of the day. A manual profile pick holds until the next switch.
settings.comfort.profile.title: Profile
settings.player.viz.desc: The visualizer pulses with your reading speed, gently idles when paused, and reacts to clicks anywhere in the window. Click the preview above to try it.
